name: lanka-monorepo
description: The lanka framework monorepo: core, modules, plugins, tools.

scripts.//scaffold: Package manifests and documentation are derived from scripts/registry.mjs. Edit the registry and regenerate: a direct edit to a package.json is overwritten, deliberately.
scripts.//check:drift: Generated output against the registry. A hand edit does not survive the next scaffold run; this check finds it before the divergence ships to npm.
scripts.//check:lockfile: The lockfile against the manifests, which is what CI installs with. It ran green here and red there once: a package was renamed and nothing local re-read the lockfile, because `check` never installs. `--lockfile-only` touches no node_modules, so this costs a fifth of a second.
scripts.//check:naming: Names: directories, files, symbols, config keys. Canon is skills/naming/SKILL.md; a rule nothing fails on diverges from the code silently.
scripts.//check:router: CLAUDE.md is AGENTS.md plus a header. One router, one wording; --write regenerates it.
scripts.//check:publishable: Publish readiness: name, version, license, repository address, private cleared. Separate from the build because the window to unpublish is 72 hours and there is no second one.
scripts.//test: Sequential, deliberately. Each vitest already fans out across every core, so eighteen at once thrash rather than share: --parallel failed three of seven runs here, in a different package each time and always with "Failed to terminate worker" rather than an assertion. Sequential passed three of three at the same wall time — 35-43s either way.
scripts.//check: Exactly what CI runs. One command, so a local green means the same as a remote one.
scripts.check: pnpm run check:lockfile && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run check:router && pnpm run check:naming && pnpm run check:docs && pnpm run check:structure && pnpm run check:composition && pnpm run check:api && pnpm run check:points && pnpm run check:twins && pnpm run check:forms && pnpm run check:parity && pnpm run check:runtime && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run test:scripts && pnpm run verify:build && pnpm run check:publishable
scripts.//check:structure: What shares a file, what a barrel holds, where a test lives. Canon is skills/structure/SKILL.md; a rule nothing falls from diverges from the code silently.
scripts.//check:composition: Function length, repeated blocks, branch shape. Canon is skills/composition/SKILL.md; the budgets are a ratchet that may only fall.
scripts.//test:scripts: The repository guard scripts. They are not workspace packages, so pnpm -r does not run them.
scripts.//check:forms: The form every published thing takes: class, factory, frozen table, ambient instance. Canon is skills/forms/SKILL.md.
scripts.//check:parity: Every role written in both styles over one implementation. Canon is skills/parity/SKILL.md.
scripts.//check:runtime: Where each package runs — browser, node, native — against what its sources actually require. Canon is skills/hosts/SKILL.md; an undeclared environment is a consumer guessing.
scripts.//check:perf: The hot paths against the recorded baseline. NOT in `check`: every other gate reads files and answers the same on any machine, while this one measures and needs an instrument — on a busy laptop or a two-core runner everything regresses together, controls included. Run it deliberately on an idle machine; :write records there, :report prints without judging and is what CI runs.
scripts.//bench: Every package's benches, printed rather than compared — for reading numbers while optimising.
